label: A lump of coal off a friend: a hard thud on a coat, soot puffing, the lump breaking
how: A fist of coal thrown hard into a crewmate: the lump's own hard knock (a real stone hit, its low end taken out) and the coat's slap, only a touch of the body's weight under them (nothing fleshy, no boom), a puff of soot off the coat, and the lump breaking as it drops off them, its pieces clinking bright and glassy on the way down.
